title: Statement from PUCT Commissioner Jimmy Glotfelty on the Publication of Texas Advanced Nuclear Reactor Working Group Report and Policy Recommendations

documents.text:
Public Utility Commission of Texas
                            1701 N. Congress, P.O. Box 13326, Austin, TX 78701

  Press Release                                                                       Contact: Ellie Breed
  Nov. 18, 2024                                                                     Media@PUC.Texas.Gov


      Statement from PUCT Commissioner Jimmy Glotfelty on the
 Publication of Texas Advanced Nuclear Reactor Working Group Report
                      and Policy Recommendations


AUSTIN, Texas – Below is a statement from Public Utility Commission of Texas (PUCT)
Commissioner Jimmy Glotfelty on the public release of the Texas Advanced Nuclear Reactor
Working Group’s final report and policy recommendations. The full report, Deploying a World-
Renowned Advanced Nuclear Industry in Texas: Considerations and Recommendations for
Action, is available on the PUCT’s website.


“I want to thank Governor Greg Abbott for his leadership on this important issue,” PUCT Commissioner
Jimmy Glotfelty said. “He recognized early on the incredible opportunity the State of Texas has to become
the world leader in advanced nuclear power and took action, creating the Texas Advanced Nuclear Reactor
Working Group to map out the future of this industry in Texas. Thanks to his foresight, Texas is already
leading the way, and we are entering the 89th Texas Legislative Session with policy recommendations that
will establish a world-renowned advanced nuclear industry.

The brightest minds in advanced nuclear energy are already here in Texas, and they were the drivers of this
groundbreaking report. I’m grateful to the nuclear industry leaders, experts from the University of Texas at
Austin and Texas A&M University, manufacturing and supply chain powerhouses, and leaders from every
level of government who served their state and participated in this effort. This report is just the beginning.
Now, Texas and our leaders are equipped with the information they need to take swift action and ensure
advanced nuclear power delivers safe, reliable, and affordable energy for generations of Texans to come.”


About the Public Utility Commission of Texas

Our mission is to serve Texans by regulating the state’s electric, telecommunication, and water
and sewer utilities, implementing respective legislation, and offering customer assistance in
resolving consumer complaints. Since its founding in 1975, the Commission has a long and proud
history of service to Texas, protecting customers, fostering competition, and promoting high
quality infrastructure. To learn more, please visit https://www.puc.texas.gov.
